scope: Retrospective offline critic diagnostic screening, no new RL, environment rollout or parameter update. F05 return/success calibration and true value calibration are NOT completed by this screen.
panel_split: Verify complete 500-step episodes from birth_steps and done/timeout flags. Sort episodes per task by birth; assign one of each consecutive pair to M and the other to A using a deterministic hash coin. Select 128 transitions without replacement from each of 8 chronological strata within each panel. M/A never share episodes. Both are already-seen replay, not untouched training data.
critic_diagnostics: At stored actions compute both Qs. Target is r+gamma*(1-done*(1-timeout))*mean_k(min Q_target(next_obs,a_k)-alpha log pi(a_k|next_obs)), k=4. RMS residual averages squared errors over both critics. RMS twin gap uses Q1-Q2. Divide each by max(RMS target,1e-6). These measure self-consistency/disagreement, NOT true value error or calibrated uncertainty.
primary_features: mean over tasks of log1p(normalized residual RMS)
mean over tasks of log1p(normalized twin-gap RMS)
outcome_split: Reuse F07 hash split: sort 100 old outcome cases per suite/task by SHA256('F07-v1|suite|task|initial_state_hash'); first50 D, last50 O. No outcomes used in splitting; already-seen historical data remain exploratory.

prediction.target: D macro success at40k minus D macro success at20k of the SAME actual continuation
base_features: parent D success of focus task
parent D success of other tasks
prediction.uniform_role: focus and other summaries both use all-task mean for Uniform
prediction.model: weighted ridge; standardize using training fold only; penalty=1 in weighted mean squared error; intercept unpenalized; no tuning or task/seed labels
prediction.raw_sensitivity: same two diagnostics without target normalization, log1p, not an extra feature search
prediction.folds: Leave out original seed11/12/13 across ALL suites/checkpoints; train on remaining2; no held-seed data in standardization, fits, or development-fixed selection.
prediction.primary_selection: Choose max(20k D macro+predicted remainder) among5 allocations within held context/continuation, score SAME actual selected40k continuation on O. No trajectory splicing; all5 20k probes are expensive historical preparation.
prediction.secondary_selection: Average predictions from other2 continuations at20k, score selected allocation on held third40k continuation, separately labelled cross-repeat transfer.
controls: Development_fixed from other2 original seeds40k D in same suite/checkpoint
prediction.tie_rule: Uniform then suite task order, absolute tolerance1e-12
prediction.aggregation: A/B/C equal weight; A200/A400 equally within A; original seeds and continuations equally. Report each group and all3 seed values.

uncertainty: No population significance claim from3 seed blocks. Descriptive paired O-case bootstrap5000 draws with policies and selected allocations held fixed, jointly resampled across continuations/allocations within task and shared across contexts of each suite. Does not cover training, fit, or diagnostic-selection uncertainty.

screen_rule.meaning: v23 operational triage, not significance or final validation; also inspect audit-panel robustness and strong controls

costs: Actual new environment/learner steps0, time inference and I/O separately. Same-repeat all5 20k probes require100k training before selection; cross-repeat requires200k. Include all diagnostic evaluation lengths in simulated costs; no equal-budget40k online claim.
